title: Gathin23/cleanyourtv
why_read: A practical utility for debloating Android TV devices, useful to many but technically modest in scope.
analysis: This tool removes bloatware and unwanted preinstalled apps from Android/Google TV devices over Wi-Fi, likely using ADB commands under the hood, and gives a cleaner launcher experience similar to Apple TV. It's a popular consumer-facing utility rather than a novel technical contribution, essentially packaging known ADB debloat scripts into a friendlier tool. Useful for end users, less interesting for engineers seeking deep technical content.
